description.value: Test plan for the **IPS Server** actor of [HL7 International Patient Summary (IPS) 2.0.1](https://hl7.org/fhir/uv/ips/). An IPS Server is a FHIR server acting as an IPS Creator by providing conformant IPS documents in response to FHIR API requests (CapabilityStatement ips-server). Each `suite` below is a `Rule:` of the Gherkin feature named by `suite.input.file`, and each `suite.test` one of its `Scenario:` lines, matched by the scenario's identifier. The assertions are the scenario's `Then` steps, verbatim. The tests declare which specification obligations they cover (9 element obligations across the plan); the coverage matrix is checked mechanically against the specification package.

purpose.value: To declare, in a machine-readable and runnable form, which behaviours a system claiming conformance to the IPS Server actor must demonstrate.
